'''Palsaang''' was a [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]]-[[City/Legends|city]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was home to the Palsaang clan, and site of a raid during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
Palsaang was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[City/Legends|city]] located in a [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr tree]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Gumbaeki]] was one of the elders in Palsaang. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of the village painted elaborate tales on the trunk of the village's trees.

==History==
The city was home to the Palsaang clan. During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], it was raided by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] led by [[Karniss]].

==Behind the scenes==
Palsaang appears in the comic arc ''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''.
